channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Alex Len | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Alex Len from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Alex Len, Moritz Wagner
item.description:
Chase Hughes:Brooks on putting Len in the starting lineup in place of Wagner:

“Just needed a change... we gave up a lot of points in the paintand we needed a different look.”

Scott Brooks on Alex Len, Moritz Wagner, Mar 13, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChaseHughesNBCS.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Alex Len
item.description:
Quinton Mayo:Scott Brooks on Alex Len:

“I like the the toughness he brings. Even the hard foul (on Zion), when’s the last time we’ve seen that? It wasn’t dirty... Whether he plays a lot of minutes early on, he’s going to be a big part of what we do here.”

Scott Brooks on Alex Len, Jan 29, 2021. Source: Twitter @RealQuintonMayo.

item.title: Luke Walton on Alex Len
item.description:
Jason Jones:Walton on Alex Len:

“It was nice to have a big body out there like that. He did a good job of clogging up that paint. We’ve got to get him a little more familiar with what we’re doing so we can open up the playbook, but he knows some of the basic sets and he helped us win.”

Luke Walton on Alex Len, Feb 22, 2020. Source: Twitter @mr_jasonjones.

item.title: Jeff Hornacek on Alex Len
item.description:
Paul Coro:About the Suns' bowling trip Tuesday, Hornacek said,

“We never say who the worst bowler is. We wouldn't call Alex Len out like that.”

Jeff Hornacek on Alex Len, Jan 6, 2016. Source: Twitter @paulcoro.

item.title: Goran Dragic on Eric Bledsoe, Alex Len
item.description:
Goran Dragic:

“Of course, we still have a lot of salary cap. Probably next year, we'll go for big names, one of the superstars. But I think we drafted well, especially Alex Len, the big guy from Ukraine. Then we brought in Eric Bledsoe from the Clippers. So I think we'll play together in the backcourt, me as a 2 or 1, him as a 1 or 2. That will be a good combo for us.”

Goran Dragic on Eric Bledsoe, Alex Len, Sep 22, 2013. Source: ESPN.com.
